description: Header file for the cSettings class that manages configuration settings stored in a JSON format. It provides methods for reading, writing, and modifying key-value pairs within the configuration, with support for different data types. Also includes lifecycle methods like constructor and destructor.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: Class to handle JSON-based configuration settings, supporting operations such as get, set, check existence, remove keys, and persist data to file.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration from a specified file.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieve the value associated with a key.

methods.name: setValue (std::string, std::string)
methods.description: Set a key-value pair where value is a string.

methods.name: setValue (std::string, int)
methods.description: Set a key-value pair where value is an integer.

methods.name: setValue (std::string, bool)
methods.description: Set a key-value pair where value is a boolean.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Check if a key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove a key-value pair from configuration.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Persist the current configuration to file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initialize configuration from the specified file.
